evolutionConsole.toolSchemaNeedChange: Nothing to submit (neither descriptions nor enabled state changed)

evolutionConsole.rollbackConfirm: Roll back the entries applied by this run? (idempotent)
evolutionConsole.rollbackDryRunBlocked: Dry-run never touched the DB — nothing to roll back
evolutionConsole.pollHint: An evolution is in progress; the list refreshes every 10s

evolutionConsole.newCaseControlHint: Required for Answer: it is the truth executed on that data source.
evolutionConsole.newCaseNameHint: Leave blank to auto-generate ui_xxxx; duplicates conflict.
evolutionConsole.newCaseNeedControl: Answer cases need a gold SQL
evolutionConsole.formDryRunHint: Draft and preview only: no DB writes, no eval. Keep it off for a real run.
evolutionConsole.formTargetCasesHint: Optional. Selected cases must be all green after the change; empty disables the hard constraint. Use "+ New case" to add one.
evolutionConsole.formSkipProbeHint: Runs a baseline over the target cases before touching the DB to detect cases that are themselves unstable (the gate then downgrades to uncertain instead of treating read noise as a result). Skipping saves one eval round; only meaningful when target cases are selected.
evolutionConsole.formPicksHint: A query_rule batch yields multiple candidates, each with a target_code. Fill to keep only the listed ones; empty = all candidates. target_code looks like Entity.field (e.g. SysRole.f_category).
evolutionConsole.formKbHint: Only optimizable knowledge bases are listed: alias needs an abstract schema; query_rule needs a data source with a compiled schema.
evolutionConsole.formDsHint: Only data sources with a compiled schema are listed.
evolutionConsole.startRunHint: Expect 10-12 minutes and ~160 real LLM calls; a non-preview run writes to the DB and auto-rolls back.
evolutionConsole.startRunBlocked: An evolution is in progress; cannot start another
evolutionConsole.libSafetyBanner: The DB may be stuck in the after-change state (stage={{stage}}) — roll back (idempotent) before any further writes.
evolutionConsole.gateHowToReadBody:
Decision: Suggest adopt = all hard constraints passed, ready for human review; Do not adopt = a hard constraint failed; Cannot decide yet = readings unstable, hold off or rerun with more repeats.
Pass count: the same cases run on the before/after schemas, compared pairwise.
Net change: after - before.
Unstable readings: the same case disagreed across repeats.
Stability probe: the target case was asked N times before the change; only an all-consistent result makes its reading trustworthy.

decisionTip.accept: All hard constraints passed; ready for human review
decisionTip.reject: A hard constraint failed; do not adopt
decisionTip.uncertain: Readings are unstable; hold off for now

evolutionConsole.gateJitterNote: These cases disagree across repeats - unstable by themselves; not the patch's credit or blame. An unstable target case downgrades the decision to uncertain (unless another hard failure applies).
evolutionConsole.gateProbeNote: The target case was asked N times to see whether results agree - prove the reading is trustworthy before comparing.
evolutionConsole.gateNone: No gate decision yet (evaluation unfinished or not gated)
evolutionConsole.entriesHint: Tick entries to adopt (all by default) → Preview → Confirm write; only that actually writes to the DB. To decline, click Reject and add a reason.
evolutionConsole.previewSkipped: Skip {{n}} entries (skip = already present or invalid; never written twice)
evolutionConsole.alreadyAdopted: This run was already adopted (duplicates are skipped)
evolutionConsole.firstAdoptV0Hint: This chain has no adopted version yet: adopting will auto-create a v0 baseline from the current schema, then apply this run's changes.
evolutionConsole.confirmWriteWarn: This really writes to the DB: auto-backup first, then re-read verification; if target cases were set, their re-run follows (may take 1-3 minutes).
evolutionConsole.adoptWarnings: Adoption completed, but these side operations failed (the result stands; please verify manually)
evolutionConsole.adoptNoop: Nothing to write (already adopted, or all present) - DB untouched
evolutionConsole.readbackFail: ✗ failed - the write may not have landed; see output below
evolutionConsole.smokeNote: Re-runs the target case after adoption to confirm it is really fixed.
evolutionConsole.rejectNote: Reject note (recorded in the rejects ledger)
evolutionConsole.rejectNeedNote: Please write a reject note first
evolutionConsole.rollbackConfirmDetail: Roll back the entries applied by this run? (idempotent)
evolutionConsole.cliFailedHint: CLI exited non-zero (business failure) - output and artifacts below are still shown.
evolutionConsole.adoptTimeout: Adopt timed out and was interrupted - the CLI may have stopped mid-write; check the run state and the DB
evolutionConsole.ledgersHint: Ledgers are stored server-side; grouped by type below:

evolutionConsole.skipWhyInDb: Already present in the schema; nothing to write
evolutionConsole.skipWhyConceptMissing: Concept not found (concepts are not auto-created; needs manual work)

evolutionConsole.skipWhyToolsFull: Tool overrides are at the 20-entry limit; this tool has no override to edit
